data.name: Shanti
data.gender_notes: Shanti is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root śam, 'to be calm, to pacify' — śānti, 'peace'. Its root is Sanskrit śam (शम्). A classical Sanskrit term for peace. Shanti is a Sanskrit name meaning “Peace; tranquillity”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shanti expresses “Peace; tranquillity”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root śam, 'to be calm, to pacify' — śānti, 'peace'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shanti total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

vedic_reference.note: Shanti is a popular name in Hindu mythology and is often used as a name for the goddess of peace and tranquility. It is also used as a name for the wife of the god Shiva in Hindu mythology.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for peace.
